title: An iridium(III) 3-chloro-6-thio-1,2,4,5-tetrazine complex for cysteine conjugation, bioimaging and photoactivated therapy
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,1148-1155
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00316K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lili Huang, Justin Shum, Lawrence Cho-Cheung Lee, Guang-Xi Xu, Peter Kam-Keung Leung, Kenneth Kam-Wing Lo
An iridium(III) 3-chloro-6-thio-1,2,4,5-tetrazine complex was modified with an RGD peptide, affording a photoactive conjugate that specifically targeted tumour cells and showed enhanced emission and singlet oxygen generation upon photoirradiation.
